terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.play.title: The game
terms.play.body: Same Pinch shows you and another player the same picture. When your thoughts meet (the same spot, or words that mean the same thing in any language) it's a Same Pinch. Your answers become labelled data that helps build better language tools for India.
terms.money.title: Paid for work, never for winning
terms.money.body: Money is paid only for matched, meaningful answers (labelling work). There are no entry fees, no prizes, no bets and nothing paid out by luck. Rankings, badges and levels give XP only. During the demo, balances are simulated and cannot be withdrawn.
terms.age.title: 18 or older
terms.age.body: You must be 18 or older to play. One account per person.
terms.data.title: Your data
terms.data.body: We store your handle, language, the answers you give and your game progress. We never sell personal data. Answers are kept, without your name, to improve the game for everyone.
terms.location.title: Location
terms.location.body: You tell us your state (and, if you like, your city). We never use GPS or ask for an address. Your state is stored with your answers so we can study how words differ across regions and languages.
terms.fair.title: Fair play
terms.fair.body: No bots, scripts, copied answers or multiple accounts. Suspicious play can be held for review, and earnings from it can be withheld.
terms.delete.title: Leaving
terms.delete.body: You can download your data or delete your account at any time in Settings. Deleting removes your profile and balance; anonymised answers stay in the dataset.
terms.changes.title: Changes
terms.changes.body: If these terms change, we'll ask you to accept the new version before you keep playing.
